news.title: RNG Tech inks deal to expand massage chair network at Lotus’s Thailand

recent_en: RNG Tech recently announced recurrent related party transactions with Gintell Thai, with the cumulative value exceeding the 1% threshold; its Thailand unit also signed a deal with Lotus's Thailand to expand its massage chair network. The company listed in July 2026 and no specific figures for the latest quarterly results are available.
notable_en: Subsidiaries RNG TH and RNG SG entered into recurrent related party transactions with Gintell Thai, with cumulative value exceeding the 1% threshold.
RNG Tech signed a deal with Lotus's Thailand to expand its massage chair network.
